_note: aax-bing-1 is a dusk street scene with a church tower (from an Expedia car-rental page), not the airport.

aax-bing-2.webp.zh: 阿拉沙机场航站楼内的候机区：值机柜台前排着队，成排的金属座椅对面是通往机坪的玻璃门。
aax-bing-2.webp.en: Inside Araxá Airport's terminal: a queue at the check-in counter and rows of metal seats facing the glass doors out to the apron.

aax-bing-3.webp.zh: 阿拉沙机场俯瞰：单条沥青跑道穿过红土高原，跑道中段一旁是机坪与机库。
aax-bing-3.webp.en: Aerial view of Araxá Airport: a single asphalt runway across red-earth plateau country, with the apron and hangars alongside its midpoint.

aax-doubao-01.webp.zh: 航站楼门楣上方用蓝色大字写着机场名称，红砖墙与锯齿形白色屋檐在蓝天下格外醒目。
aax-doubao-01.webp.en: Blue lettering across the terminal fascia spells out the airport's name above red brick walls and a zigzag white roof edge against a clear sky.

aax-doubao-02.webp.zh: 正对航站楼入口，玻璃门里是值机与行李大厅，绿色小牌写着登机与到达，天上一片晴蓝。
aax-doubao-02.webp.en: A head-on view of the entrance, its glass doors opening onto the check-in and baggage hall, with a small green boarding sign above under clear blue sky.

aax-doubao-03.webp.zh: 机场航站楼前的停车场，几辆轿车停在树荫下，红砖立面、蓝色横带和锯齿屋檐在晴空下很醒目。
aax-doubao-03.webp.en: Cars sit in the shaded car park outside the terminal, whose red brick front, blue band and zigzag roof edge stand out sharply under a bright sky.

aax-doubao-05.webp.zh: 这是一张卫星地图截图，标出阿拉沙机场的跑道、滑行道与周边街区道路。
aax-doubao-05.webp.en: A satellite map screenshot marking Araxá Airport's runway and taxiway alongside the surrounding streets, with place labels overlaid on the image.

aax-doubao-04.webp.zh: 机库敞开的门口停着一架白色公务机，机身映着滑行道与草地，舱门朝向机库外的天空。
aax-doubao-04.webp.en: A white business jet sits just inside an open hangar door, its polished fuselage reflecting the grass and sky beyond the threshold.
